leadText:
Tahnti Park (Japanese: タンティ Tahnti Park) is a park home to various species of Pokémon located in the downtown of Ryme City southeast of the central square in the game . The second part of Chapter 1 takes place here.

The park is divided into three areas: the fountain area in the center, the nature area to the west, and the café area to the east.
